items.title: Controlling Reasoning Effort in LLMs
items.content: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes
items.contentSnippet: How LLMs Learn Low-, Medium-, and High-Effort Reasoning Modes

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《控制大型语言模型的推理努力》  
文章内容：  
大型语言模型如何学习低、中、高三种推理努力模式。通过分析模型在不同任务中的推理过程，研究者揭示了其调整推理复杂度的机制，为优化模型效率提供了理论依据。
summaries.en: The article explores how Large Language Models (LLMs) learn to operate in low-, medium-, and high-effort reasoning modes. It examines the mechanisms enabling LLMs to adjust their reasoning complexity based on task requirements, input prompts, and computational constraints. The content likely discusses the factors influencing these modes, such as prompt design and model architecture, and how LLMs optimize reasoning effort for efficiency and accuracy. The focus is on understanding the adaptability of LLMs in managing computational resources during inference.

summaries.zh: 近期，新型开源大语言模型（LLM）如Gemma 4和DeepSeek V4通过KV共享、mHC（多头稀疏注意力）和压缩注意力等技术，显著降低了长上下文处理的成本。这些架构优化提高了计算效率，减少了资源消耗，使大模型在长文本任务中更具实用性。
summaries.en: Recent open-weight LLMs like Gemma 4 and DeepSeek V4 are reducing long-context costs through innovations in architecture. Key developments include KV (Key-Value) sharing, mHC (multi-head cross-attention), and compressed attention. These techniques optimize memory usage and computational efficiency, enabling better handling of extended contexts. The advancements aim to balance performance and resource consumption in large language models.

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了一种以学习为导向的工作流程，旨在帮助人们理解新的开源大模型架构发布。该流程强调系统性学习和逐步深入的方法，通过分析模型结构、训练数据和性能表现等关键信息，逐步掌握新模型的原理和应用。
summaries.en: This article outlines a learning-oriented workflow for understanding new open-weight large language model (LLM) releases. The workflow emphasizes systematic approaches to analyze and comprehend LLM architectures, focusing on key details and updates in open-weight models. It provides a structured method for researchers and practitioners to stay informed about advancements in LLM technology. The goal is to facilitate efficient learning and adaptation to new model releases.

items.title: A Visual Guide to Attention Variants in Modern LLMs
items.content: From MHA and GQA to MLA, sparse attention, and hybrid architectures
items.contentSnippet: From MHA and GQA to MLA, sparse attention, and hybrid architectures

summaries.zh: 本文是一份关于现代大型语言模型（LLMs）注意力机制变体的视觉指南。主要介绍了多种注意力机制，包括MHA（多头注意力）、GQA（通用查询注意力）、MLA（多路注意力）、稀疏注意力和混合架构。这些机制旨在提高模型效率和性能，通过不同的注意力计算方式优化信息交互。
summaries.en: The article provides a visual guide to attention variants in modern large language models (LLMs). It covers key architectures including MHA (Multi-Head Attention), GQA (Generalized Query Attention), MLA (Multi-Query Attention), sparse attention, and hybrid models. The summary highlights these diverse attention mechanisms, emphasizing their roles in enhancing model performance and efficiency.

items.summary: 本文是一份关于现代大型语言模型（LLMs）注意力机制变体的视觉指南。主要介绍了多种注意力机制，包括MHA（多头注意力）、GQA（通用查询注意力）、MLA（多路注意力）、稀疏注意力和混合架构。这些机制旨在提高模型效率和性能，通过不同的注意力计算方式优化信息交互。
